scenario.label_zh: 安排音乐会座位和散场
scenario.goal_zh: 核对座位布置、观众人数和活动后的收尾职责

context_zh: 社区古典音乐会的工作人员核对观众人数、过道和散场后的分工。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Organizer Pia
sentences.text: How many people are coming to the classical music concert tonight?

sentences.speaker: Volunteer Leon
sentences.text: We expect eighty. That is a bigger crowd than last month.

sentences.speaker: Organizer Pia
sentences.text: The entrance looks crowded already, even without the audience.

sentences.speaker: Volunteer Leon
sentences.text: These spare chairs are in the way. Shall I move them to the side room?

sentences.speaker: Organizer Pia
sentences.text: Yes, please. Keep the aisle clear, and set out eighty seats in the hall.

sentences.speaker: Volunteer Leon
sentences.text: I can also stack the chairs after the concert if someone helps.

sentences.speaker: Organizer Pia
sentences.text: I will help. For now, you move the spare chairs, and I will check the seating plan.
